findings.title: Unconditional UTF-8 decode breaks on non-UTF-8 text responses
findings.evidence: The function is documented to 'return the body as text', but it always decodes with UTF-8 regardless of the response encoding. A reachable path is any successful HTTP 200 response whose body is text in another charset, such as ISO-8859-1; after streaming completes, this line raises UnicodeDecodeError instead of returning text.
findings.recommendation: Decode using the response's declared/apparent encoding, for example by using response.encoding with a safe fallback, or return bytes and let callers choose decoding. Add tests covering non-UTF-8 text bodies.
